unit: W2 - 12 banks with logos for the Bank & Lender Match List sample

sources.book_rows: credentials/lenders-audit/lenders-unified-carl-merged.csv (gitignored local copy; row-for-row the same as the live lenders table, confirmed with a read-only SELECT on lenders)
sources.tracked_book: docs/legacy-strong/lenders-legacy-strong.csv (all 12 names are present; it carries bureaus for only 3 rows, so bureaus come from the two sources above)

book_facts.limits: The book has NO dollar limit or range for any of these banks in its limit columns (average_starting_loc, max_known_loc, typical_approval_range are empty for every row). Only KeyBank has limits, and they sit in the advisor tips text: business Visa up to $25k and/or unsecured business line of credit up to $50k.
book_facts.bureau_codes: EX = Experian, EQ = Equifax, TU = TransUnion
book_facts.business_bureau_pulled: empty in the book for all 12
book_facts.product_type: Every pick comes from the book's business card tables (OnlineBizCC or InBranchBizCC). The book names the card only for Chase, American Express, Truist (in-branch row) and US Bank; the rest have no product name in the book.
book_facts.navy_federal: Navy Federal Credit Union is in the book only as a personal loan (PersonalLoans table, 'Navy Federal Personal Expense Loan', TU). It has no business product, so it is not in the 12.

logo_notes.all_logos_are_small: Every file in public/assets/lenders is 16 to 192 px. Most are site icons, not full logos. Show them at or below native size (or at half size for sharp screens).
logo_notes.chase_file_type: chase.png is a JPEG saved with a .png name. It serves fine (HTTP 200, image/png) and has a white background.
